experiencia.cabecalho: A timeline of my journey so far
experiencia.intro: Graduated in Systems Development from COLTEC (UFMG) and currently studying Software Engineering at PUC Minas, I've had several experiences in software development and learned from each of them.
experiencia.conteudo1_1: I work as a Mid-level Developer at LayerCode, working on several projects with different technologies, focused on web and mobile development.
experiencia.conteudo2_1: I worked as a Mid-level Developer at Provatis Academy, using PHP with Laravel and React.js to develop features.
experiencia.conteudo2_2: I was responsible for refactoring and managing the company's software.
experiencia.conteudo3_1: I worked as a Junior Developer at HelpImob, maintaining the company's website and app.
experiencia.conteudo3_2: I implemented improvements and new tools for the website, using PHP with the Laravel framework, and for the app, using Flutter.
experiencia.conteudo4_1: I worked as an IT Infrastructure Assistant at Versloc, working with Power BI, the full Office package and SQL databases.
experiencia.conteudo4_2: I performed maintenance and implementation of CRM and other platforms used by the company.
experiencia.conteudo5_1: I was a Scientific Initiation scholarship holder on the Transcolar project at UFMG's School of Engineering.
experiencia.conteudo5_2: I researched and developed data transformation and aggregation techniques in the context of intelligent transportation, aiming to highlight important information, support decision-making, and detect and correct anomalies and outliers in the data.
experiencia.conteudo5_3: I worked on researching data visualization techniques and developing web applications for entering, viewing and analyzing school transportation data.
experiencia.conteudo6_1: Graduated in Systems Development from COLTEC (UFMG's Technical College).
